Map Between Voxel Indices and Physical World Coordinates

Source: R/dicom-volume.R
voxel_to_world.Rd

Maps 3D voxel coordinates (r, c, s) to physical world coordinates (x, y, z) in millimeters (in vol$coord_system, "LPS" or "RAS") and vice versa using vol$affine, supporting both R's 1-based indexing (index_base = 1L) and DICOM/C/NIfTI 0-based indexing (index_base = 0L).

Usage

voxel_to_world(vol, ijk, index_base = 1L)

world_to_voxel(vol, xyz, index_base = 1L)

Arguments

vol

A dicom_volume object.

ijk

Numeric vector of length 3 (c(r, c, s)) or N x 3 numeric matrix of voxel indices.

index_base

Integer indexing base: 1L (default, R 1-based where c(1, 1, 1) maps to vol$affine[1:3, 4]) or 0L (0-based where c(0, 0, 0) maps to vol$affine[1:3, 4]).

xyz

Numeric vector of length 3 (c(x, y, z)) or N x 3 numeric matrix of physical world coordinates in millimeters.

Value

For a length-3 vector input, a named length-3 numeric vector (c(x = ..., y = ..., z = ...) for voxel_to_world(), c(r = ..., c = ..., s = ...) for world_to_voxel()). For an N x 3 matrix input, an N x 3 numeric matrix.

Examples

aff <- diag(c(0.8, 0.8, 2.5, 1.0))
aff[1:3, 4] <- c(-16, -16, 0)
vol <- new_dicom_volume(array(0, dim = c(32L, 32L, 8L)), affine = aff)
w <- voxel_to_world(vol, c(1, 1, 1), index_base = 1L)
w
#>   x   y   z 
#> -16 -16   0 
world_to_voxel(vol, w, index_base = 1L)
#> r c s 
#> 1 1 1
